<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/142.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/142.0.0.0" version="29.2.6"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="zIn9ItICmZZPWIAeh_FE"> <mxGraphModel dx="2722" dy="1031" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <object label="" id="0"> <mxCell /> </object> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml Account_Creation_Enhanced

!theme plain
skinparam backgroundColor #FFFFFF
skinparam roundcorner 5
skinparam shadowing false

skinparam participant {
 BackgroundColor #E8F4FD
 BorderColor #2196F3
 FontColor #1565C0
 FontSize 11
 FontStyle bold
}

skinparam actor {
 BackgroundColor #E1F5FE
 BorderColor #0277BD
 FontColor #01579B
}

skinparam note {
 BackgroundColor #FFFDE7
 BorderColor #FF8F00
 FontColor #E65100
 FontSize 10
}

skinparam sequence {
 ArrowColor #1976D2
 ArrowFontColor #1565C0
 ArrowFontSize 10
 LifeLineBackgroundColor #FAFAFA
 LifeLineBorderColor #1976D2
 ParticipantBorderThickness 2
 BoxBorderColor #1976D2
}

skinparam title {
 FontColor #1565C0
 FontSize 16
 FontStyle bold
}

title **WillBank - Microservice Architecture**\n**Diagramme de Séquence: Création de Compte Bancaire**

box \"Client Layer\" #E8F5E8
 participant \"Client Application\" as Client
end box

box \"Gateway Layer\" #FFF3E0
 participant \"API Gateway\" as Gateway
end box

box \"Business Services\" #E3F2FD
 participant \"Account Service\" as AccountSvc
 participant \"Client Service\" as ClientSvc
end box

box \"Data Layer\" #F3E5F5
 participant \"Account Database\" as AccountDB
end box

box \"Integration Layer\" #FFEBEE
 participant \"RabbitMQ Broker\" as MQ
 participant \"Notification Service\" as NotifSvc
end box

note over Client, NotifSvc #FFFDE7
 **Cas d'usage:** Création d'un nouveau compte bancaire
 **Acteur:** Client de la banque WillBank
 **Objectif:** Ouvrir un compte courant avec dépôt initial
end note

== Phase 1: Demande de Création ==

Client -> Gateway: **POST** /api/accounts\n**Payload:** {\n \"customerId\": 123,\n \"accountType\": \"CHECKING\",\n \"initialBalance\": 10000,\n \"currency\": \"XOF\"\n}
activate Gateway
note right of Gateway #E8F4FD
 **Authentification & Validation**
 • JWT Token validation
 • Rate limiting check
 • Input sanitization
end note

Gateway -> AccountSvc: **CreateAccountRequest**\n**Headers:** X-Correlation-ID: req-001
activate AccountSvc

== Phase 2: Validation Métier ==

note over AccountSvc #FFFDE7
 **Règles de Validation:**
 • Client doit exister
 • Statut client = ACTIVE
 • KYC Status = VERIFIED
 • Montant initial ≥ 1000 XOF
end note

AccountSvc -> ClientSvc: **GET** /api/clients/123\n**Headers:** X-Service-Auth: internal-token
activate ClientSvc

ClientSvc -> ClientSvc: **Requête Base de Données**\nSELECT * FROM clients\nWHERE id = 123 AND status = 'ACTIVE'

ClientSvc --> AccountSvc: **Response 200 OK**\n**ClientDto:** {\n \"id\": 123,\n \"status\": \"ACTIVE\",\n \"kycStatus\": \"VERIFIED\",\n \"firstName\": \"Marie\",\n \"lastName\": \"Kouassi\"\n}
deactivate ClientSvc

alt Client valide et vérifié
 note over AccountSvc: Génération du numéro de compte
 AccountSvc -> AccountSvc: generateAccountNumber()\n→ \"WB987654321\"
 
 note over AccountSvc: Création de l'entité Account
 AccountSvc -> AccountDB: INSERT Account\n{accountNumber: \"WB987654321\", customerId: 123,\naccountType: \"CHECKING\", balance: 10000, status: \"ACTIVE\"}
 activate AccountDB
 AccountDB --> AccountSvc: Account créé avec ID=456
 deactivate AccountDB
 
 note over AccountSvc: Publication d'événement
 AccountSvc -> MQ: Publish AccountCreatedEvent\n{accountNumber: \"WB987654321\", customerId: 123, balance: 10000}
 activate MQ
 MQ -> NotifSvc: AccountCreatedEvent
 activate NotifSvc
 NotifSvc -> NotifSvc: Envoyer email de bienvenue
 NotifSvc --> MQ: Event traité
 deactivate NotifSvc
 MQ --> AccountSvc: Event publié
 deactivate MQ
 
 AccountSvc --> Gateway: AccountDto {id: 456, accountNumber: \"WB987654321\",\nbalance: 10000, status: \"ACTIVE\"}
 Gateway --> Client: 201 Created - Compte créé avec succès

else Client invalide ou non vérifié
 AccountSvc --> Gateway: 400 Bad Request - Client non éligible
 Gateway --> Client: Erreur de validation client
end

deactivate AccountSvc
deactivate Gateway

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
